scene_target: Rhea successfully forces a mob to drop untaxed raw materials by exploiting a collision between environmental damage and loot generation.
goal: Herd the scavenger into a deadfall trap and trigger it without dying from stamina-drain HP loss.
conflict: Rhea is at 0 Stamina and 1 HP; any misstep or overexertion risks instant death.
constraints: Must explicitly show Rhea managing her 0 Stamina / 1 HP state while executing the plan.
Loot dropped by the environment must not trigger a Gathering Tax notification.
end_condition: The scavenger is crushed by debris, dropping untaxed raw materials.
transition_in_text: Rhea carefully rises from her resting spot, fighting through Exhaustion to put her physics exploit into motion.

last_scene: Rhea carefully managed her 0 Stamina and 1 HP to execute a physics exploit.
She herded an ash-crusted scavenger under a deadfall trap and triggered it with her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon.
The falling debris crushed the scavenger, yielding 15 XP and untaxed raw materials.
The System failed to apply a Gathering Tax, confirming her theory that environmental collisions bypass the rigged economy.
key_events: Rhea stowed her Ash-Fungus to free her hand.
She managed her Stamina regeneration tick by tick to avoid fatal HP drain.
She lured a scavenger into a deadfall trap using a thrown stone.
She used her Makeshift Masonry Bludgeon to trigger the deadfall without triggering a combat exertion penalty.
The scavenger was crushed, granting 15 XP.
The resulting dropped loot was untaxed by the System.
